_tieu_de: Do mau chip trang thai Disabled cua Port Forwarding -- gap ghi trong ISSUES.md 'Mau chip trang thai Disabled CHUA do duoc'.
_cach_do: Anh Huynn tu dang nhap lai, vao Network > Port Forwarding, bam '+ ADD NEW', tao rule 'TestDisabledColor' (TCP, External/Internal Port 54321, Device Admin-PC) va DE TAT cong tac Enable truoc khi Save.
Doc class + CSSOM cua chip 'Disabled' vua hien qua javascript_tool (getComputedStyle + doc truc tiep document.styleSheets tim luat co selector chua 'stateDisabled').
Sau khi do xong, xoa ngay rule thu qua giao dien that (Delete + xac nhan).

ket_qua_do.chip_disabled_class: MuiChip-root MuiChip-filled MuiChip-sizeMedium MuiChip-colorDefault MuiChip-filledDefault stateDisabled css-1a2im0e
ket_qua_do.ghi_chu_css-15ejc2r: Cung mot luat mau nhung gan cho mot lop Emotion KHAC (css-15ejc2r) -- co the la bien the chip o mot trang/component khac chua xac dinh duoc pham vi (ngoai pham vi viec nay). Da ghi lai bang chung THAT nay nhung CHUA gan vao code nao, vi khong ro dung o dau -- tranh bia cach dung.
ket_qua_do.stateEnabled_khong_ton_tai: Kiem CSSOM luc do: KHONG co bat ky luat nao voi selector chua '.stateEnabled' -- xac nhan trang thai Enabled KHONG co lop state rieng, chi dung mau xanh mac dinh cua .css-1a2im0e (rgb(76,175,80) / bg rgb(232,245,233), da co san tu GD1).

ket_luan: Sua ham oChip() trong bang_binding.js: khi batTat=false (Disabled) them lop 'stateDisabled' vao class (truoc day de trong 2 khoang trang, chua biet dien gi). Them luat CSS moi '.css-1a2im0e.stateDisabled' vao emotion.css. Ham oChip() dung CHUNG cho ca bang may tinh va the dien thoai (Port Forwarding), nen sua 1 cho la ap dung ca 2 noi.
